## Problem

Describe the concrete engineering problem. Keep the setup short enough that a reader can understand the constraints before seeing the implementation details.

## Approach

Explain the chosen design and the tradeoffs. Prefer precise claims over broad summaries.

## Notes

Use margin notes when a point is useful but secondary.[^1]

[^1]: Quarto footnotes render cleanly and can be styled to feel close to Tufte-style sidenotes.

## Result

Summarize what changed, what worked, and what remains open.
